$comment: Cosmetics of the Dragon Folio set (Legends Showcase capsule machine), written by art/machine-specs.mjs from career/machines/legends-showcase.json: edit that file and re-run, not this one.
style: dramatic high-fantasy oil painting in volcanic crimson, burnished gold, and billowing ember smoke
rules: These are full-art pictures for playing cards: the client draws a small name plate over the top edge, mana symbols at the top right and power and toughness at the bottom right, so keep the main subject in the middle of the panel and the top 15% and bottom 15% calm and uncluttered (sky, ground, water, background texture), with nothing important in the corners. Each panel shows its own subject as one clear, readable scene, the same style and palette as its neighbours, as if the whole row were a matched, limited-edition art series.
spare: an extra painting in the same style: a classic crimson mountain dragon roaring atop a smoking basalt spire at sunset

items.subject: a classic crimson mountain dragon roaring atop a smoking basalt spire at sunset
an ancient horned elder dragon coiled around a floating golden gem between twin horns
a gleaming gilded dragon banking through sunlit storm clouds scattering molten gold
